segments.text:
V. 13.
That he ſhould lay his hands on them—This was a Rite which was very early uſed, in praying for a Bleſſing on young Perſons. See Gen. xlviii. 14—20.
The diſciples rebuked them—That is, them that brought them: Probably thinking ſuch an Employ beneath the Dignity of their Maſter.
